title: Cursor Plan mode: review the plan, then Build

parts.text: Plan mode lets you generate and review a detailed plan before Agent writes any code.
Agent explores your codebase and may ask clarifying questions.
Review the plan Agent creates. It opens as a virtual file you can read and edit.
When you're happy with the plan, click Build to start coding.
Agent starts coding from the plan.
Plans are saved by default in your home directory.

pick.text: Keep it in the home directory

parts.text: For future reference, team sharing, and documentation.
Plan mode works best for complex features with multiple valid approaches, tasks touching many files or systems, unclear requirements, and architectural decisions.
If Agent builds something that does not match what you wanted, use Revert on a previous chat message, then Confirm, to roll back your files.
